description: Q2 supplier risk roll-up via MCP. Agent must read 15 audit docs, apply the prose-described severity/status rubric to determine High+Open findings, correctly handle re-assessments (escalations and resolutions), and produce a summary doc with the exact line format for all 7 qualifying suppliers. Checks are capability units: per-supplier rubric application is graded per-supplier (R3a); plumbing, source integrity, and exclusion restraint each collapse to one check.
